label: EnGenius ECS1528 (24x 1G, 4x SFP+, no PoE)
description: EnGenius Cloud ECS1528 layer 2+ managed switch: 24x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45, 4x 1/10G SFP+ uplinks, 128 Gbps switching capacity, 16K MAC table, no PoE, 19-inch 1U chassis.

fabric.note: Vendor figure 128 Gbps, the full-duplex aggregate of 24x 1G plus 4x 10G (64 Gbit/s of line rate x 2). Packet forwarding rate 95.23 Mpps.

notes: Ports 1-24 are 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45; the four SFP+ cages take 100/1000/10,000 Mbps optics (the vendor hardware drawing labels them "100/1000/10,000 Mbps SFP+ Slots", so a 1G optic is supported in the cage). No PoE on this SKU: no budget is published and no port is a PSE port. 16K MAC, 1.5 MB packet buffer, 440 x 200 x 44 mm, 2.69 kg, 19-inch 1U. RJ45 console port present; the mode-selector/reset button is not a network interface. Management is EnGenius Cloud (zero-touch provisioning), the local web GUI (HTTP/HTTPS over IPv4 and IPv6) and a CLI reached over SSH/Telnet/TFTP config backup; SNMP v1/v2c/v3 with RMON 1,2,3,9 is supported. Layer 3 is static routing only: 63 IPv4 and 21 IPv6 static routes, a 192-entry ARP table and up to 20 IPv6 addresses on the box - no OSPF and no BGP, which is why this is modelled as l3-forward without a routing engine. L2 set: 802.1D/w/s spanning tree, 802.1Q tagging with port-based and protocol-based VLANs, 802.3ad link aggregation, IGMP and MLD snooping, voice VLAN, 802.1X with RADIUS, MAC/IP ACLs and storm control, 8 QoS queues. Operating 0-50 C, 5-95% RH non-condensing, 100-240 V AC 50/60 Hz, 2-year warranty. Firmware: the ECS15XX-25XX image is shared across the ECS15xx and ECS25xx classes - the download table on the model pages lists ECS15XX-25XX_firmware_1.2.136-197.imag dated 16 July 2026 as the current build, with 1.2.130-193 (27 May 2026) and 1.2.125-192 (12 February 2026) beneath it. Management is EnGenius Cloud (zero-touch provisioning), the local web GUI (HTTP/HTTPS over IPv4 and IPv6) and a CLI reached over SSH/Telnet/TFTP config backup; SNMP v1/v2c/v3 with RMON 1,2,3,9 is supported. Layer 3 is static routing only: 63 IPv4 and 21 IPv6 static routes, a 192-entry ARP table and up to 20 IPv6 addresses on the box - no OSPF and no BGP, which is why this is modelled as l3-forward without a routing engine. L2 set: 802.1D/w/s spanning tree, 802.1Q tagging with port-based and protocol-based VLANs, 802.3ad link aggregation, IGMP and MLD snooping, voice VLAN, 802.1X with RADIUS, MAC/IP ACLs and storm control, 8 QoS queues. Operating 0-50 C, 5-95% RH non-condensing, 100-240 V AC 50/60 Hz, 2-year warranty. Firmware is the separate ECS55XX image: the model page lists ECS55XX_firmware_2.2.66-174.imag as the current build, so ECS5512/ECS5512FP do NOT use the ECS15XX-25XX image. Sources: https://www.engeniustech.com/eu/products/network-switches/ecs5512fp/ (comparison table: ports 1-8 802.3af/at/bt up to 90 W, 410 W, 240 Gbps, 32K MAC, 178.57 Mpps), the model datasheet https://www.engeniustech.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/ecs5512fp-datasheet.pdf (420 W budget, 240 Gbps, 745.61 W full load, 2.61 kg) and https://www.engeniustech.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/Cloud-Switches-DS-09-29-20.pdf.
